items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Jim Cramer suggests investors should diversify their portfolios by focusing on consumer stocks instead of relying only on struggling AI-related investments. Google's stock fell to a six-month low after its AI-powered search summaries reduced ad revenue. Intel's stock fell to its lowest point since the 1970s, losing about $12 billion in value from the government's ownership. A security researcher found a hardcoded password in Applebee's app, which let hackers access customer data freely.
